[[File:Barrows Teleport icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Barrows Teleport''' teleports the caster to the [[Barrows]].

In order to cast this spell, players must have spoken to [[Tyss]] to unlock the [[Arceuus spellbook]]. Completion of the quest [[Priest in Peril]] and receiving [[Drezel]]'s warning is required to use the teleport. Casting Barrows Teleport requires 83 [[Magic]] ([[Temporary skill boost/Magic|boosts]] can be used).

This spell can be added to the [[teleport nexus]] and [[Portal chamber|portal frame]] inside a POH.
